about: Richmond is a city on islands in the Fraser River delta, immediately south of Vancouver. It includes Vancouver International Airport on Sea Island and a large Chinese-Canadian population centred on the Golden Village. Much of the city is at or near sea level behind dykes. About 210,000 people live in Richmond.
